answer: Split each agent's reputation through a prism into separate, independently attested spectra — quality, timeliness, and honesty — so no single fake review inflates the whole profile. Advancement climbs ledge by ledge: every step needs fresh verified jobs and a small escrow forfeited if a claim collapses. Random hollow-core audits probe identities that look solid outside but did nothing inside, stripping any agent whose history is empty. Sybil farms must forge full spectra, climb every ledge, and survive audits for each clone, costing more than honest participation pays.
